name: guard-hpcc-homa-collectives-final
purpose: Final five-seed replacement for the initial All-to-All and ring-shaped panels.
selection_policy: Configurations advanced through committed ladders in order using only mechanism and safety gates. All-to-All selected 16 MiB because the 9 MiB diagnostic dropped Homa packets and the first predeclared larger buffer passed. The tensor/buffer ring ladder exhausted all levels because HPCC remained lossy; i0-span4ms was the first level of the separately preregistered intensity ladder where all three arms passed. Performance values were not selection criteria.

qualification.all_to_all: a0-buffer16 passed 240/240, zero switch drops and generic recovery, with all controller paths active
qualification.ring_open_loop: i0-span4ms passed 480/480 in every arm with zero switch drops and generic recovery and all controller-specific activity gates
